The child reproduces C09's distinctive Clinton-era monument framework: the same establishment formula, an almost verbatim expanded public-land withdrawal, an off-road vehicle prohibition framed around protecting identified objects, an identical federal water-reservation clause, a state fish-and-wildlife savings clause, valid-existing-rights language, dominant-reservation language, and the standard warning. C14 and C08 share substantial portions of the same framework, but C09 is strongest because it also contains the vehicle, water, and state-jurisdiction provisions adapted in the
